notes: «وَ عَنْهُ» opens the report: «عنه» is Hakim b. Dawud, the first link of report 1 (prev1, which writes its chain), and the text then goes on «عن سلمة», as prev1 does; so Hakim is taken over as inherited, first
the bracketed readings «[هاشم]», «[أحدهما]» and «[الْمُهْتَدُونَ]» are alternative spellings, not links; the surfaces are the text's main words
«أحدهم» is the Imam written after «عن» inside the chain: narrator (ruling 2); «بعض أصحابنا» is unnamed; the blessing is left out
